roi.title: Estimate your BUY clicks and your bill
roi.lead: Enter the monthly sessions on the pages where the widget is shown. We apply the rates from our pilot to show how many BUY clicks that could mean and what the Online store plan would cost at that volume.
roi.visitsLabel: Sessions per month on pages with the widget
roi.visitsHint: From your own analytics. An illustration, not a forecast.
roi.cost: Online store plan at that volume
roi.fine: How it is computed: visits × {search} (sessions that start a search in the pilot) × {click} (of those, sessions ending in a BUY click in the pilot) = BUY clicks. The Online store plan costs {base} a month plus {perClick} per click. These are pilot rates; yours will differ.
roi.after: How many of those shoppers buy depends on your product page and checkout. We do not forecast sales.
roi.largeNote: The Online store plan covers catalogs of up to {max} wines. For a larger catalog, talk to sales.

founder.title: A word from the founder
founder.placeholderTag: Placeholder: the owner supplies the text, the photo and the LinkedIn link
founder.placeholder: The founder's short note goes here.
founder.quote: Wine should be easy to buy and fun to explore, not an exam. Younger shoppers want to say what they feel like drinking, in their own words, and get a straight answer. Wineater gives your own bottles that conversation, so a new generation finds your wines, trusts your shelf and comes back.
founder.name: Alex Olkhovoi
